scope: Static trace of the original PC ENG3 parent and child visibility route through the pinned callback wrappers, host table targets, and FT4 producer. No native execution or full camera reconstruction.
prediction: Final-packet scaling alone cannot recover content rejected by an earlier indexed-coordinate or camera-depth gate. The selected route's actual projection center, focal value, and indexed-bound meaning may depend on external state not established by the producer spans.
falsifier: The prediction is falsified if byte-pinned code shows the relevant route emits every packet before any coordinate/depth rejection, or if the selected route itself obtains requested output dimensions and derives its center/focal/bounds from them. A culling statement requires the exact reads, signedness, and rejecting branch to be pinned.
evidence_basis_before_trace: Shared ENG3 evidence already identifies the parent predicate and child depth helper; this trace independently checks those spans and extends the parent helper through its complete 0x24BB0 body.
Shared callback evidence identifies the 320x240 native presentation boundary; it does not establish that 160x120 is passed as the runtime projection center.
Unknown callback, table, or initializer state remains unresolved and cannot count as a successful execution result.
